root.note: The welcome map with **two extra levels** added under the keyboard branch. Columns are generated per depth, so level 4 and 5 must line up and keep readable connectors.

children.note: Every action is a keystroke on the **focused** node.
It inserts a sibling _after_ the focused node and moves the caret there.

children.text: Level 4 — at the end of a branch
children.note: The new node becomes the last child of the same parent.

children.text: Level 5 — and the caret follows it
children.note: Focus always moves to the node you just made, so you can keep typing.

children.text: Level 4 — in the middle of a branch
Level 5 — the nodes below shift down
Tab — indent (become a child of the node above)
Level 3 — the first sibling cannot indent
children.note: There is no previous sibling to become a child of, so the key is ignored instead of failing.

children.text: Shift+Tab — outdent (become a sibling of the parent)

children.note: Any node can carry a longer **description** in Markdown, shown in the side panel. Press **Alt+Enter** to edit it.

children.text: Nodes with a description show a 🗒
children.note: See? This node has its own description.
Your map is **auto-saved in this browser**. Save / Save As export a `.json` file; Open loads one back.
